How we work

Built by hand, tested on the bench

We are a builder-led company. Theory matters — but every claim we make has to survive contact with real hardware, real signals, and real measurements.

1

Design

Start from the physics: what signal exists, what would prove it, and what control would disprove it. The experiment is designed before the hardware is.

2

Build

Assemble the prototype ourselves — optical bench, detector chain, embedded electronics, and the software that ties them together.

3

Test

Measure against phantoms and negative controls. If the effect disappears under a proper control, we say so and redesign.

4

Iterate

Feed what the bench taught us back into the next design. Small team, short loop, no handoffs between the person who designs and the person who tests.

Flagship research

UNIQUE — UNifying Imaging with QUantum Entanglement

Can entangled photons show us more?

UNIQUE is our flagship research direction: an investigation into whether quantum-correlated photons — including the paired 511 keV photons produced by positron annihilation — carry imaging information that classical methods leave on the table.

The idea is concept-stage and we frame it that way. The work is phantom and benchtop validation only: build the measurement, establish the observables, and find out — with controls — whether the correlation signal holds up before anyone talks about applications.

Scope, stated plainly

What UNIQUE is
  • Concept-stage research
  • Phantom & benchtop validation
  • 511 keV correlation observables
What it is not
  • Not a clinical product
  • No human trials
  • No claimed clinical results

Correlation as signalCoincidence timing between paired photons becomes the measurement — not just intensity.

Controls before conclusionsNegative controls and phantom ground truth decide what the data is allowed to claim.

Honest stage, honest claimsAn early research program, described as one — no devices, trials, or results implied beyond the bench.

Custom orders

Custom 3D printed artifacts

Alongside the research work, we take custom orders for 3D printed pieces — made one at a time, to order, in our own shop. There is no catalog and no checkout: every order starts with a conversation about what you need.

Custom decor

One-of-a-kind decorative pieces designed and printed to order — tell us what you have in mind, and we will model it in 3D CAD, render it for your approval, and print the finished piece.

Replacement parts, reverse-engineered

A broken plastic component that is discontinued or hard to find does not have to stay broken. From a few measurements and photos of the original part from every side and angle, we recreate it in CAD — a process we have replicated using multiple 3D rendering applications — and print a replacement to order.

How it works

1

Send measurements & photos

For a replacement part, send a few key measurements of the original component and clear photos of every side and angle. For decor, send your idea or reference images.

2

CAD recreation & rendering

We rebuild the piece as a 3D CAD model and render it so you can see exactly what will be printed before anything is made.

3

Printed to order

Once the model looks right, we print your piece to order. Get in touch to discuss your part or project and we will take it from there.

Start a custom order

Custom orders are arranged by email — no online store, no cart.

About

A small company, deliberately

Precision Forge Holdings LLC was founded in New Jersey in July 2026 to do one thing well: early-stage research that most organizations are too large to start — the uncertain first experiments where a new sensing idea either shows its first real signal or gets honestly ruled out.

Staying small is the strategy. The person who frames the hypothesis is the person at the bench, which keeps the loop between idea and evidence short — and keeps our claims exactly as strong as our measurements, never stronger.

  • Builder-led: prototypes designed, assembled, and tested in-house.
  • Evidence-first: controls and phantoms before conclusions, always.
  • Federal R&D ready: SAM.gov registered and active, pursuing the SBIR/STTR lane.
